title: Golf scores
observableEvidence: Orders several signed numbers on a number line to identify the smallest value in context.
prompt: Four contestants' scores relative to par are -3, 2, -7, and 0. In golf a lower score is better. Which score is the best result?
solutionRepresentation: Ordering the four scores from least to greatest: -7, -3, 0, 2. The lowest score, -7, is the best result.
solutionMethod: Order the signed numbers on a number line; the value farthest left is the smallest.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept -7 written with a minus sign or the word negative.

hintSteps.prompt: In golf, a lower score is better, and negative numbers are lower than zero or positive numbers.
hintSteps.question: Which of the four scores is the smallest when compared on a number line?

hintSteps.prompt: Order all four scores from least to greatest, keeping negative numbers to the left on a number line.
hintSteps.question: Which score sits farthest to the left after ordering all four?

hintSteps.prompt: In a similar contest with scores -2, 4, -9, and 1, the best (lowest) score is the one farthest left on the number line, since -9 is less than -2.
hintSteps.question: Using that same idea, which of this contest's four scores sits farthest left?

review.originalityStatement: Written for this repository from first principles.

accessibilityNotes: Present all four scores as plain signed-number text; do not depend on a scoreboard image or color.
